entities.summary: Joseph Oliver Launchbury is an English rugby union lock currently playing for Harlequins in PREM Rugby. He represented England at international level and previously played for the under-18s and under-20s before making his Test debut in 2012. Launchbury plays mainly in the second row but is also comfortable as a blindside flanker.
